questions.stem: What role do platelets play in the body?

options.text: They produce antibodies to fight infections
They help blood to clot at wound sites to prevent blood loss and infection
They carry dissolved nutrients around the body
They transport oxygen from the lungs to the tissues

questions.explanation: Platelets are cell fragments that play a key role in blood clotting. At a wound site, they help form a clot by triggering the conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin, which seals the wound.
